P7765.corridor_notes: 安旬天然气长输管线项目：起点安康，终点旬阳，途经汉滨区、旬阳、高新区。项目2016年曾获批但搁置，2020年11月正式重启前期工作；截至2023年2月仍处于协调阶段，已列入《陕西省石油天然气“十四五”发展规划》，陕天然气股份公司与旬阳市政府正就下游燃气经营市场收购事宜磋商，尚未开工建设。 (Consistent with GEM Status_sheet = proposed.)
P7765.researcher_notes: Two Ankang municipal-government sources (2021 proposal response, 2023 people's congress reply) corroborate the corridor at city/county granularity, matching GEM's own StartLocation=Ankang / EndLocation=Xunyang exactly. Neither source names specific station-level endpoints (consistent with pre-construction/proposed status — no station siting yet). Used Hanbin District (Ankang's urban core) for the start point since the 2021 source explicitly names it as the first corridor county.
